status: Independent single-photo camera calibration incorporated; metric uncertainty and hidden depths retained.
north_side_observed_sequence: near narrow/wide/narrow group, three separate central windows, one rear curved-gable axis; lower bays obscured
uncertainties: Independent camera calibration gives nominal stone bands 4.8/9.4/14.2/19.0 m. Interpretation and 256-sample ranges are recorded separately, not precision claims.
Window and column widths are photograph proportions, not surveyed dimensions.
North-side grouping is visible in 2012; exact depth spacing is an estimate.
South fourth-floor nine-axis grouping is photo-observed, but exact depth spacing and obscured lower glazing remain estimates.
Back elevation, roof junctions, dome depth and rear finials have no survey/aerial evidence.
Sign typeface, carved relief and curtain placement are approximations.

Rear roof front setback 3 m is a conditional interpretation fitted to the photographed central triangle, not a measured depth. The previously arbitrary 10.5 m setback is rejected as inconsistent with the low-camera visibility.
2016 resolves four rectangular roof lights with arched stone hoods and a separate central triangular pediment; 2025 confirms exposed tops, while lower roof openings remain partly hidden.
Ground windows: three columns and at least five visible rows; exact lower division heights behind planters are estimated.
Garuda silhouette, major colored parts and layer order follow the visible 2025 sculpture; feathers, relief depth and tiny scroll inscription remain approximate.
Metal cap silhouette height is retained; fine curved subdivisions reduce coarse facets. Dark finish and seam interval are photograph estimates, not sampled material measurements.
south_side_observed_sequence: 2025 enlarged source supports a near triplet, three central openings and a far triplet on the fourth storey, 9 axes; lower floors partly obscured. Roof is flat behind the front drum, not the northern curved-gable profile.
metric_method_note: Canon EOS M2, 25 mm focal length, 22.3 x 14.9 mm sensor and frozen 29.3297 m nominal front width; single-plane line calibration, 256 sensitivity samples. Not a survey.
roof_profile_note: 2012 opposite oblique and 2025 show two finials along an elongated rounded-cap ridge. Width shrinks toward the crown while depth retains 45%, not a point apex. At front crown depth -2.39 m, chosen Z24.0 projects to about22.53 m in the nominated facade plane; hidden profile remains estimated.
